technical_and_design_decisions: Ambari integration for Spring XD on YARN will be structured using standard Apache Ambari service definition templates and lifecycle scripts.
Spring Cloud Config Server integration for spring-bus will utilize spring-cloud-config-client to pull externalized properties during bootstrap.
Serialization performance measurements for Spring XD will cover standard Java serialization, Kryo, and custom tuple format benchmarks.
Support for fsUri=file:// will modify Spring XD Hadoop configuration bean creation to handle org.apache.hadoop.fs.LocalFileSystem without forcing HDFS cluster connection checks.
Sqoop task launcher in Spring XD will be extended with an explicit systemProperties configuration map that passes JVM arguments (-Dkey=value) to the Sqoop child process.
assumptions: Development and integration testing will be conducted by a single software engineer with expertise in Spring ecosystem, Hadoop, and YARN.
A local or sandbox environment with Apache Ambari, YARN, and Hadoop is available for testing Ambari plugins and YARN deployments.
User stories U3 (channel performance investigation), U4 (serialization baselines), and U5 (bus architecture review) produce investigation reports and design documents in addition to any code updates.
Spring XD version target for the Ambari upgrade path is from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA.

activities.activity_name: Ambari Support for Spring XD on YARN (U1)
activities.activity_description: Develop and configure Apache Ambari stack service definitions and scripts to deploy and manage Spring XD on a YARN cluster.

activities.activity_name: Spring Cloud Config Integration for Spring Bus (U2)
activities.activity_description: Update spring-bus modules to integrate with spring-cloud-config server for centralized external configuration management.
Profile and benchmark message channel performance in Spring Integration 4.2, identify bottleneck areas, and document findings.
Create performance benchmark suites for Spring XD payload serialization mechanisms to establish baseline throughput and latency metrics.

activities.activity_name: Spring Bus Architecture and Design Review (U5)
activities.activity_description: Review current spring-bus architecture and design specifications to identify foundation-level gaps and propose architectural improvements.

activities.activity_name: Spring XD Ambari Plugin Upgrade to 1.2 GA & Documentation (U6)
activities.activity_description: Update Ambari plugin manifests and scripts to upgrade Spring XD from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA and write user documentation for the upgrade process.
Enhance Spring XD Hadoop jobs (e.g., jdbchdfs) to accept file:// URIs using LocalFileSystem without requiring a running Hadoop cluster.

activities.activity_name: System Properties Support for Sqoop Jobs (U8)
activities.activity_description: Extend Sqoop job execution configuration to allow passing user-specified system properties into the standalone Java process launched for Sqoop.
Perform comprehensive end-to-end integration testing across all implemented features, ensuring compatibility and stability.
